crossRefs.note: He will come into the realm of the king of the south, but he will return into his own land.

translations.web: He will come into the realm of the king of the south, but he will return into his own land.
translations.bsb: who will invade the realm of the king of the South and then return to his own land.
translations.kjv: So the king of the south shall come into his kingdom, and shall return into his own land.
translations.asv: And he shall come into the realm of the king of the south, but he shall return into his own land.
